Confess which inputs can never be computed before presenting the result
Narrate one full round in names, then compress the rest

main_argument_chains.claim: Eleven coastal states sink within two centuries, eight powerful states owe the response, bargaining assigns five of the displaced peoples, and a culture survives only with little intermarriage and strong inheritance.
support_steps: Stand each coastline in for a cone and correct the density with five-meter data
Project a steady rise and a speeding one, and date eleven states
Rank states on emissions, product and density
Run a pressure game until someone accepts and everyone pays
Prove the bearer dynamics stable inside an explicit region
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Settle arrivals together and school them for the first decades, then switch to free movement with strong cultural protection.
